1879090219.name: Swat
1879090219.desc: Swat the whiny little things so they fly away. Sometimes, they run slow after.

1879094827.name: Sticky Tar
1879094827.desc:
Smash a phial of sticky tar onto the ground.

Slows movement speed of enemies who run through tar, and makes them vulnerable to attack.
This vulnerability will continue for a time after an enemy has left the tar or the tar has dissipated.

conditionalEffects.description: Insult to Injury:\nWhen used, Ancient Craft and Bane Flare will each cause your next Lightning skill to deal bonus Damage.\nTest of Will and Sticky Tar will each cause your next Fire skill to deal bonus Damage.

1879096875.name: Slashing Claws
1879096875.desc: Your companion slashes at their enemy with razor-sharp claws, leaving them bleeding.

1879109291.name: Essence of Storm
1879109291.desc: Summon the essence of a thundercloud's lightning, which deals extra damage on critical hits.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Hits with Essence of Storm will remove the induction from Essence of Winter.

1879157291.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle, who has trained as a Sage.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish, while out of combat.</rgb>

1879230635.name: Pack Flayers
1879230635.desc: You sink your teeth into your opponent and shake violently, rooting them in place and lowering their defences.

1879231403.name: Ranged The Dark Before Dawn
1879231403.desc: A Gambit which restores Power and grants some Power-over-Time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879244843.desc: A violent strike against the target that focuses on your offensive capability, dealing damage and increasing threat against the target.

1879250987.name: Measured Attack
1879250987.desc: Using the speed and momentum of your horse, you swing mightily against your opponent, attempting to weaken their defences.

1879252267.name: Speed of Worry
1879252267.desc: Frodo has a lot to think about, and the worries that weigh so heavily do not slow his steps.

1879266859.name: Make Your Own Luck!
1879266859.desc: Saeradan is unusually lucky, especially for a Dúnedan. This surprising good fortune often reveals itself as a decline in the melee effectiveness of his foes.

1879288363.name: Restoration
1879288363.desc: A masterful skill which applies a powerful heal-over-time effect.

1879291307.name: Fire and Frost Lore
1879291307.desc: Your knowledge of the elements is able to weaken and dismay your foe, reducing their Outgoing Damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Using a Lore skill will briefly reduce your Incoming Damage

1879305387.name: Left and Right
1879305387.desc: Treebeard crushes the ground before him with two powerful swings.

1879334571.name: Toss Keg
1879334571.desc: Light and toss a keg onto the battlefield.

1879367979.name: Beaver
1879367979.desc: Brings out a beaver to keep you company.

1879386027.name: Night Squirrel
1879386027.desc: Brings out a night squirrel to keep you company.

1879387307.name: Goat of the Moria Sentinel
1879387307.desc: A goat employed in the protection of Moria.

1879388587.name: Amethyst Neekerbreeker
1879388587.desc: Brings out an amethyst Neekerbreeker to keep you company.

1879449387.name: Call Gorwen
1879449387.desc: You can use this horn to call Gorwen to your side.

1879456427.name: Steed of Cardolan's Dawn
1879456427.desc: A steed for new beginnings and glorious adventures.

1879468971.name: Catch a Breath
1879468971.desc: You are able to catch your breath to restore morale and power.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a block or parry response.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 1% of your max power.
Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 4% of your max power.
Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 3% of your max power.
Critical hit with your parry response skills will restore 2% of your max power.

1879471275.name: Fire Pot
1879471275.desc: A pot filled with a foul-smelling sludge and set alight.

conditionalEffects.description: Haversack skills may reduce your target's Outgoing and Incoming Damage.
Pot skills may increase incoming damage.

1879480619.name: Ill Omened Jackal
1879480619.desc: Summons a friendly jackal to accompany you on your travels.

1879485995.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Hobbit-lass)
1879485995.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879486507.name: Dusky Parrot
1879486507.desc: Summons a dusky parrot to accompany you on your travels.

1879491115.name: Wizard's Fire
1879491115.desc: A basic sigil which burns your foe over a brief time and restores your Power.

conditionalEffects.description: Wizard's Fire burns enemies around your target.

1879491499.name: Guide to Urmâkh
1879491499.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Urmâkh in Imhûlar in the Ikorbân Valley.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879500459.name: Portent of Strength - 150
1879500459.desc: A quick burst of strength, increasing the amount of damage you do.

1879516459.name: Smelling Salts
1879516459.desc: Foul-smelling salts will rouse you from any negative combat states, at a cost.

1879523243.name: Reckless Attack
1879523243.desc: When filled with Blind Rage, make a final and devastating attack, dealing great damage at the cost of some Morale, ending your rage.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires Blind Rage.</rgb>

conditionalEffects.description: Critical hits with Reckless Attack grant you a Parry Response.
